Unseenlabs, a pioneer and global leader in space-based radio frequency surveillance

Founded in 2015 by the Galic brothers, Unseenlabs is a pioneer and global leader in RF services for multi-domain awareness. Our French company operates and develops a constellation of nanosatellites and microsatellites specialized in the detection of radio frequency (RF) signals for maritime, land, and space monitoring.

With headquarters in Rennes, offices in Paris and Singapore, and a team in the United States, Unseenlabs brings together around 150 team members. This international presence allows us to support customers worldwide, while continuing to develop our technologies and to operate our constellation from France.

We currently operate 25 satellites in orbit!

An innovative Technology Serving Multi-Domain Awareness

Our technology detects, geolocates, and characterizes RF signals emitted by electronic equipment.

In the maritime domain, it notably enables the detection and tracking of non-cooperative vessels whose declarative systems, such as AIS, are switched off or manipulated.

Operational day and night, and regardless of weather conditions, our monosatellite technology complements existing surveillance systems and provides a better understanding of human activities on a global scale.

With Gen 2, we are expanding this expertise beyond the oceans. Our multi-domain capabilities enable us to observe and better understand activities across maritime, land, and space environments.

This evolution opens up new technological challenges and new possibilities for our teams!

Watch Our Last Film

Since 2019, Unseenlabs has been making invisible activity at sea visible.

With Gen 2, our second generation of satellites, Unseenlabs is expanding its space-based radio frequency detection capabilities beyond maritime domain awareness to support multi-domain awareness across maritime, land, and space.

This new generation is designed to deliver more actionable RF data and insights, helping customers worldwide better understand increasingly complex operational environments and make informed decisions.

The Call marks the beginning of this new era!

Behind every signal, there is a team

Designing satellites, operating a constellation, and transforming radio frequency data into actionable information require a wide range of skills.

Space engineering, radio frequency, signal processing, software development, data, satellite operations, production, product, sales, and support functions: our roles are diverse, but they all share the same ambition.

The arrival of Gen 2 opens a new chapter for Unseenlabs. It leads us to develop new technologies, explore new areas of application, and strengthen our expertise.

At Unseenlabs, every person contributes directly to the development of our satellites, technologies, and solutions.

We are looking for curious, demanding, and committed people who are ready to work on complex technological projects and take on high-impact challenges.

Our Vision

Our ambition is to push the boundaries of space-based RF detection in order to reveal what remains invisible and contribute to a safer world.

As pioneers in space-based RF maritime surveillance, we have launched our first Gen 2 satellite for multi-domain detection across maritime, land, and space environments.

This transformation relies above all on the women and men who make up Unseenlabs: passionate, expert, and complementary teams united by the same desire to innovate and build useful and sovereign solutions.

We want to continue our development by creating an environment where everyone can contribute, grow, and take on responsibilities, regardless of gender, origin, or background.

Our values

  • Collective Ambition

    We are driven by a collective ambition. Together, we move forward with commitment and humility to build solutions that are meaningful, responsible, and impactful.

  • Cohesion

    Respect, trust and solidarity form the foundation of our daily cohesion. The collective is just as important as the individuals who make it up. We place great importance on well-being, creating a work environment that is healthy, fair, and authentic.

  • Innovation & Expertise

    We forge our own path with rigor and high standards. Being a pioneer means surrounding ourselves with committed talent and partners who complement one another.

  • Open-mindedness

    We embrace diverse perspectives with respect and create opportunities for everyone to contribute. Our differences are a real source of strength, helping us explore new ideas and broaden our collective vision.

Shaping the future of our industries, together!

The space, technology, and engineering sectors are still marked by an imbalance in representation between women and men.

At Unseenlabs, we want to actively contribute to changing this reality.

We are committed to raising awareness of the diversity of our professions, encouraging women to join scientific and technological fields, and supporting their access to all levels of responsibility.

This commitment is reflected in fair recruitment processes, the promotion of diverse career paths and role models, and the creation of a work environment where everyone can find their place, express themselves, and grow.

Because innovation is fueled by diversity of experience, skills, and perspectives, we want to build teams that are increasingly representative and inclusive.
